integrity: The finite formulas are derived from uniform-surjection counting, exchangeable-sample variance identities, and a direct multinomial-occupancy covariance calculation. An independent exact enumerator recomputes all ordered bootstrap resamples through size six for multiple fixed data profiles.
scientific_limitations: The result is for the equal-weight ordinary nonparametric bootstrap with resample size equal to the source sample size.
Support size counts represented source labels, not distinct numerical values when source observations tie.
The theorem gives a conditional mean and covariance, not a full conditional distribution or stochastic-ordering result.
title: Exact support-size regression of bootstrap sample variance
